Market today: Mixed signals. The Qualcomm/Amazon chip deal is a strong positive for the semiconductor sector, which is your core. However, rising Brent crude oil prices to $98 could fuel inflation fears, potentially weighing on growth stocks.

Your holdings: SOXL (-50.9%) and SPAL (-33.08%) need immediate attention. Both are leveraged ETFs, amplifying losses, and SPAL has already blown past its stated stop. Margin amplifies these drawdowns.

Watch: Keep an eye on oil prices for broader market sentiment. Also, watch how the positive chip news translates into sustained strength for your tech holdings.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged, deeply underwater positions to protect your capital.
plays: Review SPAL (price 16.83, stop 21.38, -33.08% PnL). Your stop is above current price; consider trimming or exiting to manage risk on this leveraged position.
Review SOXL (price 124.95, -50.9% PnL). This leveraged position is deeply underwater; consider adjusting your stop or trimming to reduce exposure.
